summary: NatWest Group plc filed a 6-K reporting daily open-market purchases under its existing buyback programme executed through UBS AG, London Branch, per instructions dated 16 February 2026. Over 28 September-2 October 2026, 8,438,633 ordinary shares were repurchased across LSE, CHIX, and BATE at volume-weighted average prices ranging roughly GBp 649.78-689.13, with intraday extremes of GBp 643.80-692.00. Repurchased shares will be cancelled. Post-settlement, NatWest holds 178,229,251 shares in treasury and 7,932,902,747 shares outstanding. Watch for continued daily disclosures and the pace of cancellation affecting EPS accretion and total voting rights.
